nodes.label: Owner decision: defer the OpenBao reference driver
nodes.rationale: Deferred not cancelled: the trait seams exist and are conformance-tested with the embedded arm, embedded is the documented default, and the driver's cost is front-loaded (bao in the dev container, no CI, and a risky enrollment transaction reorder). Counter-argument recorded: a seam with one implementation is an untested abstraction.

nodes.label: D6 — v1 ships the seams plus one reference provider
Enrollment transaction reorder forced by OpenBao serial stamping
nodes.rationale: OpenBao cannot stamp caller-supplied serials, so CertProfile::serial: Some(_) must be rejected and the flow splits into txn-1 token-spend -> sign -> txn-2 cert row with a compensating mark-failed and orphan sweep — the trait shape not surviving contact with a real backend.
